name: Qatar (QCS 2014 with BS 8110 / BS 6399)
description: A thin pack for Qatar (alpha 9 track C23): the Qatar Construction Specifications 2014 refer the structural design to the British Standards, so it extends the legacy pack bs8110 (BS 8110-1:1997 concrete, BS 6399 loads with the standard wind method, BS 5950-1 steel) and sets Qatar's towns with the basic wind speed (one SAEngine practice value, to be checked), a coastal town site as the default terrain and the 'severe' exposure for new concrete members. Earthquake: not covered (QCS 2014 and the British Standards give no seismic loading; zone 0, no earthquake cases; a Z entered per project uses the parent's spectrum, named BNBC 2020). The Gulf's temperature range is not a pack value: enter the uniform change in Project Settings > Temperature (README). QCS's own durability rules and the Eurocode route that newer Qatari projects follow are not included (choose eurocodes for that). Every value is listed in VERIFY.md.
